import sys

def solve_luka_problem(N, sums):
    # Create a matrix to represent the system of linear equations
    A = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    b = [0] * N
    
    # Fill the matrix and vector based on the given sums
    for i in range(N):
        A[i][(i - 1) % N] = 1
        A[i][i] = -2
        A[i][(i + 1) % N] = 1
        b[i] = sums[i]
    
    # Solve the system of linear equations using Gaussian elimination
    for i in range(N):
        # Find the pivot row
        max_row = i
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            if abs(A[j][i]) > abs(A[max_row][i]):
                max_row = j
        
        # Swap rows
        A[i], A[max_row] = A[max_row], A[i]
        b[i], b[max_row] = b[max_row], b[i]
        
        # Normalize the pivot row

        b[i] /= factor

def reconstruct_ring(N, sums):
    # Create the matrix A for the system of equations
    A = np.zeros((N, N), dtype=int)
    for i in range(N):
